collection.title: Exam Relaxation & Study-Break Scheduler
collection.description: Zero-AI study relaxation tools featuring drift-free animated breathing timers, 6 exam-anxiety technique cards, and a gentle Pomodoro study-break timer.
collection.scopeLabel: Study-Skills & Relaxation Tools — Zero-AI, Non-Medical Exam Stress Support

items.subject: Wellbeing
items.body: 5-4-3-2-1 Sensory Grounding Method: Quickly interrupt panic or racing thoughts before an exam by connecting with your physical environment.

metadata.title: 5-4-3-2-1 Sensory Grounding
steps: 5 Things you can SEE: Look around your desk or room and notice 5 distinct objects.
4 Things you can TOUCH: Feel your chair, your pen, your desk, or your clothes.
3 Things you can HEAR: Listen closely for ambient sounds like a fan, clock, or distant footsteps.
2 Things you can SMELL: Notice any subtle scents around you or inhale your sleeves.
1 Thing you can TASTE: Focus on the present taste in your mouth or take a sip of water.
metadata.summary: Proven sensory awareness technique to bring your focus back to the present moment when feeling overwhelmed.

items.subject: Wellbeing
items.body: 5-Minute Pre-Exam Brain Dump: Clear working memory capacity before starting a test paper.

metadata.title: 5-Minute Pre-Exam Brain Dump
steps: Take a blank rough sheet of paper 5 minutes before study or during allowed rough work time.
Write down every formula, date, equation, or worry currently cluttering your mind.
Don't worry about neatness or order—just transfer thoughts from head to paper.
Once on paper, trust that your brain doesn't need to hold them in active memory.
Begin your test with a clean, unburdened mental slate.
metadata.summary: Frees up working memory bandwidth by offloading anxious thoughts onto rough paper.

items.subject: Wellbeing
items.body: Progressive Muscle Relaxation (PMR): Systematically release shoulder, neck, and hand tension.

metadata.title: Progressive Muscle Tension Release
steps: Sit comfortably in your chair with feet flat on the floor.
Tense your shoulders up towards your ears tightly for 5 seconds.
Release suddenly and feel the warm sensation of relaxation flowing down.
Clench your hands into fists for 5 seconds, then unclench completely.
Repeat 3 times while taking slow, natural breaths.
metadata.summary: Physical tension release helps lower physiological heart rate and stress hormone levels.

items.subject: Wellbeing
items.body: Cognitive Reframing of Exam Nerves: Shift perspective from 'I am anxious' to 'My body is energized'.

metadata.title: Reframing Exam Nerves into Energy
steps: Recognize that a fast heartbeat is adrenaline helping your brain think faster.
Reframe: Say to yourself, 'I am not panicked; my body is preparing to perform.'
Acknowledge what you have studied rather than focusing on unstudied topics.
Focus only on the current question in front of you, not the total exam score.
metadata.summary: Transforms physiological arousal into positive performance readiness.

items.subject: Wellbeing
items.body: Single-Task Focus Method: Eliminate decision fatigue during study sessions.

metadata.title: Single-Task Monotasking Protocol
steps: Select exactly ONE topic or chapter for your current 25-minute focus block.
Put your phone in another room or turn on 'Do Not Disturb' mode.
Close all irrelevant browser tabs and notifications.
If a random thought pops up, write it on a side sticky note to handle later.
metadata.summary: Protects deep focus by eliminating context-switching and multi-tasking fatigue.

items.subject: Wellbeing
items.body: Post-Exam Mental Reset: Boundary setting after completing a test paper.

metadata.title: Post-Exam Closure Protocol
steps: Once an exam paper is handed in, refrain from dissecting answers with classmates immediately.
Pack your stationery away neatly to signal closure to your mind.
Drink a glass of cold water and take a 10-minute walk outside.
Focus your attention forward onto the next subject rather than past answers.
metadata.summary: Establishes a firm mental boundary after exams to prevent post-test rumination.
